tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on P2 Conservation And Efficiency

questions.question: Foundation A device has a total energy input of 1000 J. The useful energy output is 700 J. Calculate the efficiency as a percentage.
Foundation A motor has an input power of 400 W and an efficiency of 75%. Calculate the useful output power.
Higher An electric kettle is 90% efficient. It transfers 180 000 J of useful energy to the water. Calculate the total electrical energy input.
questions.correctAnswer: Total energy in = useful energy out ÷ efficiency = 180 000 ÷ 0.90 = 200 000 J.
questions.explanation: Answer: Total energy in = useful energy out ÷ efficiency = 180 000 ÷ 0.90 = 200 000 J.
